summary: New feature: legendary leonida_marlin catch triggers a fullscreen catch-video sequence (CatchVideo.tsx + LegendaryCatch.tsx) before the reward screen. Verified happy path, skip button, 404-video fallback, coin-once guarantee, and that other species (epic/mythic) are unaffected. Backend suite 83/83 green (no DB changes in this step, as noted). One pre-existing stale check (leonida-fishing-full-game-flow) from iteration 9 targets an obsolete canvas-minigame UI that no longer exists in the current bait/species fishing implementation -- unrelated to this feature, flagged as a note, not a regression caused by this change.
action_items: Stale browser check 'leonida-fishing-full-game-flow' (created iteration 9) targets testids (fishing-start-overlay, fishing-canvas, fishing-pause-button, BEISS bite indicator, fishing-game-over) that belong to a much earlier canvas-based mini-game implementation. The fishing feature has since been fully redesigned into the bait/species/coin system (fishing-cast-button, fishing-bait-sheet, etc. -- in use since at least iteration 44). This check has not been part of any regression run since iteration 9 and is unrelated to the legendary-catch-video feature added in this iteration. Recommend the check be rewritten against the current UI or removed; not fixed here per scope (browser checks/backend tests/reports only).

checks.criterion: SQL/backend regression (no DB change expected this step)
checks.name: backend pytest suite
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q: 83 passed, 1 warning in 12.19s. No regressions; no new backend code in this step (video feature is purely client-side; coins already granted server-side by reel_fishing_cast as before).

checks.criterion: Legendärer Fang startet die Vollbild-Fangsequenz (video overlay, source, coins)
checks.name: fishing-legendary-catch-video-fallback-flow
checks.evidence: Mocked start_fishing_cast/reel_fishing_cast (species_id leonida_marlin, coins 250). After reel-button tap, fishing-catch-video-overlay appeared (portal in body) with <video data-testid=fishing-catch-video playsinline preload=auto> and <source src=/videos/legendary-catch.mp4>. GET /videos/legendary-catch.mp4 via page.request returned 200/206 with content-type video/mp4 (curl cross-check earlier: '200 video/mp4' and '206 video/mp4' for Range request). Tap mid-video did not close the overlay (controls=false, no click handler on the video itself). Playwright-Chromium lacks H.264, so canPlayType fails -> overlay auto-closed and fishing-legendary-catch reward screen appeared within the expected fallback window. Title contained '🏆' and 'LEGENDÄRER FANG!', fishing-legendary-coins counted up to '+250', 'LEONIDA COINS' text and fishing-legendary-fish image visible. 'Weiter' (fishing-legendary-continue) returned to fishing-cast-button. reel_fishing_cast called exactly once throughout.

checks.criterion: Überspringen nur über Button oben rechts
checks.name: fishing-legendary-catch-skip-button
checks.evidence: fishing-catch-video-skip bounding box confirmed in the top-right quadrant of the 390x844 viewport (x > width/2, y < 150). Clicking it immediately closed the overlay and showed fishing-legendary-catch; reel_fishing_cast/start_fishing_cast each called exactly once.

checks.name: fishing-legendary-catch-video-404-fallback
checks.evidence: Routed /videos/legendary-catch.mp4 to return HTTP 404. Overlay still appeared, then auto-closed to fishing-legendary-catch within 15s (error path triggers the same onDone -> reward flow as the H.264-unsupported fallback). reel_fishing_cast called exactly once. One console 404 entry logged as expected (intentional mocked failure), non-blocking.

checks.criterion: Coins genau einmal, unabhängig vom Video (skip/error/weiter don't retrigger reel/start)
checks.name: fishing-legendary-catch-video-fallback-flow / fishing-legendary-catch-skip-button / fishing-legendary-catch-video-404-fallback (combined)
checks.evidence: Across all three legendary-catch checks, reelCalls/startCalls were asserted to stay at exactly 1 after skip, after video fallback-closes, and after tapping 'Weiter' -- no additional RPC calls observed.
